001package io.github.ai4ci.output;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import java.util.stream.IntStream;
005import java.util.stream.Stream;
006
007import org.mapstruct.Builder;
008import org.mapstruct.Mapper;
009import org.mapstruct.Mapping;
010import org.mapstruct.NullValueCheckStrategy;
011import org.mapstruct.NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy;
012import org.mapstruct.factory.Mappers;
013
014import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Calibration;
015import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Contact;
016import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Outbreak;
017import io.github.ai4ci.abm.OutbreakBaseline;
018import io.github.ai4ci.abm.OutbreakHistory;
019import io.github.ai4ci.abm.OutbreakState;
020import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person;
021import io.github.ai4ci.abm.PersonBaseline;
022import io.github.ai4ci.abm.PersonDemographic;
023import io.github.ai4ci.abm.PersonHistory;
024import io.github.ai4ci.abm.PersonState;
025import io.github.ai4ci.abm.TestResult;
026import io.github.ai4ci.abm.inhost.InHostModelState;
027import io.github.ai4ci.util.Binomial;
028
029/**
030 * Mapper responsible for converting domain model objects into CSV DTOs.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * This abstract MapStruct mapper centralises the logic used to produce
034 * CSV-friendly immutable transfer objects for reporting and downstream
035 * analysis. Typical inputs are outbreak, person and history objects and outputs
036 * are immutable CSV types defined in this package (for example
037 * {@code ImmutableOutbreakCSV}, {@code ImmutableLineListCSV}).
038 * </p>
039 *
040 * <p>
041 * Downstream uses: the CSV DTOs produced by this mapper are consumed by
042 * reporting and analysis routines external to the core simulation. See the
043 * {@code io.github.ai4ci.output} package for the DTO types and the
044 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.abm.Outbreak} and {@link Person} classes which provide
045 * the inputs to the mapper.
046 * </p>
047 *
048 * @author Rob Challen
049 */
050@Mapper(
051                builder = @Builder(buildMethod = "build"),
052                nullValueCheckStrategy = NullValueCheckStrategy.ALWAYS,
053                nullValuePropertyMappingStrategy = NullValuePropertyMappingStrategy.IGNORE,
054                imports = { Calibration.class }
055)
056public abstract class CSVMapper {
057
058        /**
059         * Shared mapper instance obtained from MapStruct. Use this to access the
060         * mapping functions from elsewhere in the codebase.
061         */
062        public static CSVMapper INSTANCE = Mappers.getMapper(CSVMapper.class);
063
064        /**
065         * Convert a project Binomial object to a probability for CSV output.
066         *
067         * @param binom the Binomial to convert
068         * @return the probability represented by the Binomial
069         */
070        public double fromBinom(Binomial binom) {
071                return binom.probability();
072        }
073
074        /**
075         * Produce an infectivity profile CSV stream for the supplied outbreak. Each
076         * element represents the probability of transmission at a given time lag
077         * tau.
078         *
079         * @param outbreak the outbreak from which to derive the profile
080         * @return stream of {@link InfectivityProfileCSV} records
081         */
082        public Stream<InfectivityProfileCSV> infectivityProfile(Outbreak outbreak) {
083                var dd = outbreak.getBaseline()
084                        .getInfectivityProfile();
085                return IntStream.range(0, (int) dd.size())
086                        .mapToObj(i -> this.toIP(outbreak, i, dd.density(i)));
087        }
088
089        /**
090         * Map outbreak behaviour counts to CSV DTOs.
091         *
092         * @param outbreak the outbreak state providing behaviour counts
093         * @return stream of behaviour count CSV records
094         */
095        public Stream<OutbreakBehaviourCountCSV> toBehaviourCSV(Outbreak outbreak) {
096                var cs = outbreak.getCurrentState();
097                return cs.getBehaviourCounts()
098                        .entrySet()
099                        .stream()
100                        .map(kv -> this.toBehaviourCSV(cs, kv.getKey(), kv.getValue()));
101        }
102
103        /**
104         * Map outbreak behaviour counts to CSV DTOs.
105         *
106         * @param state     outbreak state providing behaviour counts
107         * @param behaviour the type of behaviour (e.g. "home", "work", "other")
108         * @param count     the count of agents exhibiting this behaviour in the
109         *                  outbreak state
110         * @return CSV DTO for the behaviour count
111         */
112        public abstract ImmutableOutbreakBehaviourCountCSV toBehaviourCSV(
113                        OutbreakState state, String behaviour, Long count
114        );
115
116        /**
117         * Map outbreak contact counts to CSV DTOs.
118         *
119         * @param t outbreak instance containing contact counts
120         * @return stream of contact count CSV records
121         */
122        public Stream<OutbreakContactCountCSV> toContactCSV(Outbreak t) {
123                var cs = t.getCurrentState();
124                return cs.getContactCounts()
125                        .entrySet()
126                        .stream()
127                        .map(kv -> this.toContactCSV(cs, kv.getKey(), kv.getValue()));
128        }
129
130        /**
131         * Map outbreak contact counts to CSV DTOs.
132         *
133         * @param state    outbreak state providing contact counts
134         * @param contacts the type of contacts (e.g. "home", "work", "other")
135         * @param count    the count of contacts of this type in the outbreak state
136         * @return CSV DTO for the contact count
137         */
138        public abstract ImmutableOutbreakContactCountCSV toContactCSV(
139                        OutbreakState state, Long contacts, Long count
140        );
141
142        /**
143         * Convert a person's contacts (from their current history snapshot) into CSV
144         * contact records. Only contacts where this person is participant1 are
145         * exported.
146         *
147         * @param person the person whose contacts to export
148         * @return stream of contact CSV records
149         */
150        public Stream<ImmutableContactDuckDB> toContacts(Person person) {
151                return person.getCurrentHistory()
152                        .stream()
153                        .flatMap(
154                                ph -> Arrays.stream(ph.getTodaysContacts())
155                                        .filter(c -> c.getParticipant1Id() == person.getId())
156                                        .map(c -> this.toCSV(ph, c))
157                        );
158        }
159
160        /**
161         * Map debug parameters for an outbreak into a CSV DTO. The mapping includes
162         * calibrated values derived via {@link Calibration}.
163         *
164         * @param outbreak the outbreak
165         * @param baseline outbreak baseline parameters
166         * @return CSV DTO containing debug parameters
167         */
168        @Mapping(
169                        target = "averageContactDegree",
170                        expression = "java(Calibration.averageContactDegree(outbreak))"
171        )
172        @Mapping(
173                        target = "percolationThreshold",
174                        expression = "java(Calibration.percolationThreshold(outbreak))"
175        )
176        public abstract ImmutableDebugParametersCSV toCSV(
177                        Outbreak outbreak, OutbreakBaseline baseline
178        );
179
180        /**
181         * Convert an outbreak history record to a CSV DTO. The observation time is
182         * taken from the entity current state time.
183         *
184         * @param history outbreak history record
185         * @return CSV DTO for the outbreak history record
186         */
187        @Mapping(
188                        target = "observationTime",
189                        source = "entity.currentState.time"
190        )
191        public abstract ImmutableOutbreakHistoryCSV toCSV(OutbreakHistory history);
192
193        /**
194         * Convert an outbreak state into a CSV DTO representing the outbreak.
195         *
196         * @param state the outbreak state
197         * @return CSV DTO for the outbreak
198         */
199        public abstract ImmutableOutbreakCSV toCSV(OutbreakState state);
200
201        /**
202         * Map a person and their demographic and baseline information to a CSV DTO
203         * for demographic exports. The mapper extracts the person id and demographic
204         * attributes for inclusion in the CSV.
205         *
206         * @param person   the person to map
207         * @param demog    the person's demographic information
208         * @param baseline the person's baseline information
209         * @return CSV DTO for the person's demographics
210         */
211        protected abstract ImmutablePersonDemographicsDuckDB toCSV(
212                        Person person, PersonDemographic demog, PersonBaseline baseline
213        );
214
215        /**
216         * Map a person history and contact to a CSV DTO for contact exports. The
217         * mapper extracts the person id and contact participant ids for inclusion in
218         * the CSV.
219         *
220         * @param person  the person whose history is being mapped
221         * @param contact the contact to map, which should involve the person as
222         *                participant1
223         * @return CSV DTO for the contact
224         */
225        @Mapping(
226                        target = "id",
227                        source = "contact.participant1Id"
228        )
229        @Mapping(
230                        target = "contactId",
231                        source = "contact.participant2Id"
232        )
233        protected abstract ImmutableContactDuckDB toCSV(
234                        PersonHistory person, Contact contact
235        );
236
237        /**
238         * Map a person state to a line list CSV DTO. The mapper extracts the person
239         * id and risk model log odds for inclusion in the line list.
240         *
241         * @param state the person state to map
242         * @return line list CSV DTO
243         */
244        @Mapping(
245                        target = "personId",
246                        source = "entity.id"
247        )
248        @Mapping(
249                        target = "logOddsInfectiousToday",
250                        source = "riskModel.logOddsInfectiousToday"
251        )
252        public abstract ImmutableLineListDuckDB toCSV(PersonState state);
253
254        /**
255         * Map a test result and corresponding person history to a CSV DTO for test
256         * results. The mapper extracts the person id and test time from the person
257         * history, and the test name from the test result parameters.
258         *
259         * @param t  the test result to map
260         * @param ph the corresponding person history providing context for the test
261         * @return CSV DTO for the test result
262         */
263        @Mapping(
264                        target = "time",
265                        source = "ph.time"
266        )
267        @Mapping(
268                        target = "id",
269                        source = "ph.entity.id"
270        )
271        @Mapping(
272                        target = "type",
273                        source = "t.testParams.testName"
274        )
275        @Mapping(
276                        target = "sampleTime",
277                        source = "t.time"
278        )
279        public abstract ImmutablePersonTestsDuckDB toCSV(
280                        TestResult t, PersonHistory ph
281        );
282
283        public abstract ImmutablePostVaccineCSV toPostVaccineCSV(
284                        Outbreak o, int personId, InHostModelState<?> state
285        );
286
287        public abstract ImmutableViralChallengeCSV toViralChallengeCSV(
288                        Outbreak o, int personId, InHostModelState<?> state
289        );
290
291        /**
292         * Convenience: map person demographics to the CSV DTO used for demographic
293         * exports.
294         *
295         * @param person the person whose demographics to export
296         * @return demographic CSV DTO
297         */
298        public ImmutablePersonDemographicsDuckDB toDemog(Person person) {
299                return this.toCSV(person, person.getDemographic(), person.getBaseline());
300        }
301
302        /**
303         * Map the current outbreak state to a CSV DTO representing the final state
304         * of the outbreak. This is used for final state exports and includes
305         * cumulative counts and other summary statistics.
306         *
307         * @param currentState the current outbreak state
308         * @return CSV DTO for the final outbreak state
309         */
310        public abstract ImmutableOutbreakFinalStateCSV toFinalCSV(
311                        OutbreakState currentState
312        );
313
314        /**
315         * Map an outbreak's infectivity profile to a CSV DTO. Each record represents
316         * the probability of transmission at a given time lag tau.
317         *
318         * @param outbreak    the outbreak from which to derive the profile
319         * @param tau         the time lag for this profile entry
320         * @param probability the probability of transmission at this time lag
321         * @return CSV DTO for the infectivity profile entry
322         */
323        protected abstract ImmutableInfectivityProfileCSV toIP(
324                        Outbreak outbreak, int tau, double probability
325        );
326
327        /**
328         * Map an outbreak to a CSV DTO representing the outbreak configuration. This
329         * includes parameters from the outbreak baseline and other setup parameters
330         * that define the initial conditions of the outbreak.
331         *
332         * @param outbreak the outbreak to map
333         * @return CSV DTO for the outbreak configuration
334         */
335        @Mapping(
336                        source = "baseline",
337                        target = "outbreakBaseline"
338        )
339        public abstract ImmutableOutbreakConfigurationJson toJson(Outbreak outbreak);
340}
